name: Replace simulated durable writes in work-queue tests with real PGlite assertions
description: Rewrite existing work-queue tests so they prove durable authority, not just behavioral shape. Every test that claims lifecycle correctness must query WorkItemTable, WorkAttemptTable, DeadLetterTable, and Valkey pending/stream state in the same assertion. Remove in-memory Set terminal facts. Tests like crash-after-durable-write-before-ack, Valkey wipe recovery, retry, and dead-letter must inspect both PGlite and Valkey state.
